# 404 Advisory

> Business and technology consulting firm. Team with 10+ years of experience as consultants at global firms including Ernst & Young and Accenture, with hands-on experience as business operators. Supports IT strengthening, SOP development, business consulting, and structured operational transformation.

404 Advisory helps businesses build IT systems, define standard operating procedures, and run structured operational transformation projects. Past work spans custom ERP/business systems, landing pages, and backend/automation scripts.

## Services
- IT strengthening / systems build (custom ERP, internal tools, automation)
- SOP (standard operating procedure) development
- Business consulting
- Structured operational transformation

## Project examples
- [Doomsday ERP System (Demo)](https://doomsday.404advisory.live): Mini ERP for survival-kit bundle sales - BOM-driven component requirements planning against stock and purchase orders, FIFO batch costing.
- [Static Landing Page - Draft 1](https://rockielp.404advisory.live): Landing page built per client request.
- [Simple Landing Page - Draft](https://stevenlp.404advisory.live): One-page landing site.
- [PHP Google Drive Player](https://phpplayer.404advisory.live): PHP script project (media player / bypass tooling).
